nativeBaseline.reference: native select when sufficient; custom button/listbox when justified

library: Maintain trigger-to-popup relationships, selection state, keyboard focus and native-equivalent form participation.
consumer: Author labels, options and values; prefer native Select when its behavior suffices.

notes: Custom Select remains a button/listbox composition; prefer native select for ordinary form selection. Form participation, required/invalid/reset and a fully deterministic relationship API remain unresolved.
Native auto popover owns stacking and light dismissal; CSS anchor positioning owns placement. The runtime owns committed value/open state, eligible navigation and focus restoration.
React/Vue content remains mounted while closed. Automated evidence does not establish full accessibility or native form equivalence.
